statement.ja: EPGを開いたとき、現在のprogram、channel、timeを見つけやすくし、現在のplaybackへ戻りやすくする。

conditions: People first open the EPG.

rationale.en: Applying this guidance supports a consistent and usable Live-viewing apps experience on the scoped Apple platforms.
rationale.ja: この指針は、対象AppleプラットフォームにおけるLive-viewing appsの一貫性と使いやすさを支えます。

manual: Does the design satisfy “When the EPG opens, make the current program, channel, and time easy to spot and current playback easy to resume.” in the documented Live-viewing apps context?

anti_patterns: Ignoring this guidance in a context where the source section applies.
positive_examples: A design review records how the implementation satisfies this rule and any source-scoped exception.

source.evidence_paraphrase: When the EPG opens, make the current program, channel, and time easy to spot and current playback easy to resume.

apple_native_rule: When the EPG opens, make the current program, channel, and time easy to spot and current playback easy to resume.
portable_interpretation: Preserve the user-centered intent after replacing Apple-specific platforms, components, and input conventions.

title: Consider quick-access EPG channel groups

statement.en: Consider a My Channels or Favorites group for frequently viewed EPG content.
statement.ja: 頻繁に見るEPG content向けにMy ChannelsまたはFavorites groupを検討する。

conditions: The EPG contains enough content for a personalized shortcut group to help.

title: Group EPG content into familiar categories

statement.ja: EPG contentを見つけやすい馴染みあるcategoryにgroup化する。
